listing.name: God of War II — GoW2-nativo-PS2 (cxldsakeb)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the first playable area, cutscenes and saves at about 60 FPS. No player release is offered yet; Portcove has not confirmed performance. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA NTSC-U SCUS97481 v1.01 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s extraction, Ghidra, recompilation and native VU build instructions locally. This is separate from the PlayStation 3 HD and web-engine projects.

warnings: Upstream reports the first playable area, cutscenes and saves at about 60 FPS. No player release is offered yet; Portcove has not confirmed performance.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
